acceptance: The hash keeps the hunk header's function context, or each hunk's position relative to the previous one, while still surviving a plain rebase
A test shows a moved edit gives a different digest, and a rebased identical patch the same one
The #2769 replay fixture still shows the rebase carried
description: protocol.file_patches replaces each hunk header with a bare "@@" so that rebases keep the hash. Moving an added or removed line to another place in the same file, where the three context lines match, therefore gives the same per-file hash and digest. The earlier SHIP is then carried to a semantically different head without review. Deferred from #2784 (Medium).
